title: A fair examination helps a thought grow

captions.energy: Matching a conclusion to its foundations

meaning: Comparing foundations stepwise can make your shared view fruitful and give a concrete intention room to develop.
text: A precise examination can bring warmth when a living thought grows from it. The Emperor in the physical position of Ajna suggests organising reasons and distinguishing the conditions of a shared question. Justice in energy supports the wish to match a conclusion to its foundations and give observations appropriate weight. The Empress in emotions enjoys fruitful understanding. You may find pleasure in seeing how an honest comparison created a possibility that did not previously exist in a finished form.

For example, you consider a small book exchange with friends. First you separate questions about selection, timing and access to books for each person. **A proportionate conclusion gives a living intention more room to grow.** A shared wish list proves more useful than everyone bringing an equal number of books. The reason becomes clear: being able to find interesting reading matters most. Examination has preserved different people’s involvement and given the idea a simple workable form. You can now see which differences deserve attention as discussion continues.

The difficulty is treating the pleasing result as proof that the intention already accounts for every need. Wanting to develop the discovery, you may hear another observation as returning to a settled question. Your wish for proportion can reveal its scale. One additional example can refine understanding while preserving the idea’s fruitfulness. Pleasure in development can bear examination when living material retains room to guide it.
